title: import
description: Payload of `stride import <dir>` — a Strava bulk-export archive read from disk. `imported` counts activities written to the mirror tier; `skipped` counts rows the CSV carried that were already present or unparseable. Import is additive and idempotent: re-running it over the same export imports 0 and skips the rest, so the pair is a diff against what the database already had, not a count of what the archive contained. Neither number is an error signal — a failure is an error envelope, not a zero.
